_note: Manually curated coal fiscal data. Royalties and corporate tax are derived from FOB export value via the rates below (Queensland/NSW coal royalty regime is tiered; a blended effective rate is used). Update annually after reviewing sources.
_sources: Queensland Department of Resources – Coal Royalties
ATO Tax Transparency Report (large companies, annual)
Department of Industry, Science and Resources – Resources and Energy Quarterly

_units.royaltyRateFOB: blended effective fraction of FOB export value (state coal royalties)
_units.corporateTaxRateFOB: approximate fraction of FOB export value attributable to company tax
_units.costBasisPerMtMin: AUD millions per million tonnes — low-cost Bowen/Hunter operations
_units.costBasisPerMtMax: AUD millions per million tonnes — higher-cost operations incl. rail and port
